title: Divisor quotients of algebraic strict henselizations of prime localizations
statement: Let $R,C$ be commutative rings, $q\subset R$ prime, and $A=R_q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $K$ be a field with a separable-closure structure over the residue field of $A$, an $A$-algebra structure compatible with its residue-field algebra structure, and let $C$ be an $A$-algebra which is an algebraic strict henselization of $A$ relative to $K$ [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let $b:R\to C$ be a ring homomorphism such that $R\to A\to C$ equals $b$, and let $f\in q$. Then there exist a prime $p\subset R/(f)$, a field $L$ which is a separable closure of the residue field of $B=(R/(f))_p$, compatible residue-field and $B$-algebra structures on $L$, and a $B$-algebra structure on $C/(b(f))$ such that it is an algebraic strict henselization of $B$ relative to $L$.

source.place: Tag 05WS, algebra.tex, lemma-quotient-strict-henselization; localization of quotient as in Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Ideal

proof.text: For the given prime p whose contraction is q, let A=R_q, J=(f), and I=J A. The image of q.primeCompl in R/J equals p.primeCompl. The Mathlib quotient-localization instance and IsLocalization.algEquiv identify A/I with (R/J)_p as R/J-algebras. Its composite pi with the quotient map is surjective with kernel I and agrees with the canonical map on elements of R.

The equation hbase identifies I.map(algebraMap A C) with (b(f)). Transport the supplied quotient algebra structure and hcomp along this ideal equality. Localization extensionality extends hcomp from R to A, giving precisely the compatibility equation for the upstream surjective-quotient theorem. Apply that theorem to conclude the chosen-action strict-henselization statement.

To recover the existential node statement, take p=q/J using f in q, take the canonical separable closure L of the residue field of B=(R/J)_p, and give L its B-action through the residue map. Ideal.Quotient.lift constructs R/J -> C/(b(f)). Elements outside p lift to elements outside q, whose images are units in C and hence in C/(b(f)); IsLocalization.lift therefore constructs the B-action. IsLocalization.lift_eq proves hcomp, so the upstream theorem applies. Package these explicitly constructed witnesses. This is the construction in the geometric consumer, and it works also when f=0.

theorem IsStrictHenselization.localized_divisor_quotient
    (R C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing C]
    (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime]
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) K]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) K]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) K]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) K]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) C]
    (hC : IsStrictHenselization (Localization.AtPrime q) K C)
    (b : R →+* C)
    (hbase : ∀ r : R, algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) C
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) r) = b r)
    (f : R) (p : Ideal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) [p.IsPrime]
    (hp : p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = q)
    (L : Type u) [Field L]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) L]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) L]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) L]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) L]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (C ⧸ Ideal.span {b f})]
    (hcomp : ∀ r : R, algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (C ⧸ Ideal.span {b f})
      (algebraMap (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (b r)) :
    IsStrictHenselization (Localization.AtPrime p) L (C ⧸ Ideal.span {b f})
lean.note: Retired the Sheaf copy in favor of the adopted upstream compatible-action theorem. The unchanged existential node statement follows by taking p = q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f})), L = SeparableClosure (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)), and the quotient action constructed by Ideal.Quotient.lift followed by IsLocalization.lift. Every denominator is a unit because it lifts to an element outside q. IsLocalization.lift_eq gives the required hcomp. The complete old existential signature was compiled in a sandbox-only attachment check, using only the three allowed axioms; the same witness construction is used in the adapted geometric consumer.
